faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Ahmedabad Executive - Accounts recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Executive - Accounts position at IIM Ahmedabad is 30-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive - Accounts post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Com (full time) from a recognized university and CA Inter / M.Com from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience is required, preferably in an educational institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Executive - Accounts position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive - Accounts post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, IIM Ahmedabad provides age relaxation as per GOI rules, and an additional 5 years of age relaxation is given to women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Executive - Accounts role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Executive - Accounts position is as per Pay Level 2 under the pay matrix of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIM Ahmedabad Executive - Accounts recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIM Ahmedabad website on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential skills required for the Executive - Accounts post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a working knowledge of SAP and MS-Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), along with good written and verbal communication skills.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The links for the official notification PDF and the online application form are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
